howto: Tap the big coin to earn coins.
Buy buildings: each one earns coins every second, even while you are away.
Own 25, 50 or 100 of a building to double its output. At 1M coins earned, Prestige for golden coins that raise all income by 10% each.
tips: Cursors also make every tap stronger.
Use the ×10, ×25 and MAX buttons to buy in bulk.
Send a Trade Caravan with spare coins: it comes back with 1.5 to 2.4 times as much.
A Golden Rush doubles taps for 12 seconds: tap fast!
Claim the Daily Tribute once a day for a minute of income.

controls.keyboard: Tab to a button and press Enter or Space. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the coin and the buy buttons

difficulty: An idle curve: each building costs 15% more than the last, and every prestige resets buildings but multiplies income, so each run goes further.

cheats.effect: Gold rain: 1M coins (or ten minutes of income, whichever is more)
Midas touch: every tap is worth 10 times more
Time warp: one hour of income right now

features.offline-earnings: Welcome back card: coins earned while away at 50% rate, up to 8 hours
features.upgrade-tree: Ten buildings from Cursor to Empire, each with ×2 milestones at 25, 50 and 100 owned, plus deeds worth +2% each
features.big-number-format: Coins shown as 1.2K, 3.4M, 5.6B and on to Qi
features.prestige-or-next-goal: Prestige for golden coins (+10% income each) with a progress bar to the next golden coin
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first visit: tap, buy, milestones and prestige; replay with Learn to play
features.results: Prestige card with coins this run, all-time earnings, golden coins and the new multiplier
